summary: Nyxoah SA furnished a Form -K reporting third-quarter 2026 financial and operating results via press release, quarterly report, and supplemental risk factors. Global net revenue was EUR 9.2 million, up 19% sequentially, with U.S. net revenue of EUR 6.7 million, up 29% sequentially. The company also disclosed submission of a PMA supplement to the FDA seeking to expand the Genio indication to Complete Concentric Collapse patients. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock applies; no special-situation event is present.
